items.title: Add evidence quality scoring and weak-test gate
items.context: Milestone 2: koala validate should classify weak verification evidence such as echo/version/help-only/compile-only evidence, require meaningful commands or artifacts for high-risk claims, and block weak evidence in strict or anti-hallucination style policies while warning in balanced mode.
items.userSees: Weak evidence is reported with quality diagnostics; strict validation blocks weak evidence instead of letting a checklist pass on shallow commands.

happy.desc: Strict validation accepts a checklist evidence item that has a meaningful project test command, assertion-bearing test file/artifact, current head/material metadata, and a pass result.

edge.desc: Balanced profile does not block legacy or weak evidence, but emits a clear quality warning tied to the checklist item and weakness reason.
Old evidence lacking newly introduced optional quality fields remains readable and does not crash validate.

adversarial.desc: A fake verifier attempts to satisfy strict evidence using only echo pass/version/help-only/compile-only output; validate rejects it with a weak_evidence diagnostic.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:evidence-quality-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:evidence-quality-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Strict profile accepts meaningful smoke/contract evidence and the build/test suite passed at commit cda88b6a.
Balanced profile keeps weak evidence non-blocking while recording qualityIssues and rendering weakness diagnostics.
Default/light and legacy no-options coverage remain readable and do not crash or introduce qualityIssues.
Strict profile rejects fake echo/version/help/build-only evidence as weak and getBlockingVerificationEvidenceIssues emits one detailed blocker.

items.title: Add reviewer quorum and differentiated verifier policy
items.context: Milestone 3: high-risk stories should be able to require multiple reviewer lanes and distinguish producer/reviewer actors/providers, with conflict/dispute handling when reviewers disagree.
items.userSees: Koala reports reviewer quorum status and blocks TEST/DONE when required independent reviewer evidence is missing or conflicting.

happy.desc: High-risk story review evidence with required independent reviewer lanes and no disputes satisfies quorum diagnostics.

edge.desc: Balanced profile reports missing differentiated verifier metadata as warning instead of blocking existing flows.
Reviewer lane source stays aligned with existing active reviewer computation.

adversarial.desc: The same actor/provider tries to act as producer and verifier; strict review/validate blocks or reports differentiated-verifier failure.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:reviewer-quorum-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Strict quorum accepts required independent reviewer lanes and build/quorum/flow tests passed at commit 534e515b.
Balanced profile reports missing verifier metadata as warning while keeping quorum ok; covered by reviewer-quorum smoke Test 3.
Reviewer lane source is aligned with computeActiveReviewers; smoke Test 5b imports computeActiveReviewers and feeds its output into quorum evaluation.
Strict same producer/verifier actor/provider and missing lanes are rejected by quorum diagnostics; covered by reviewer-quorum smoke Tests 2 and 4.

items.title: Add structured CI and human attestation checks
items.context: Milestone 4: CI/human evidence must be structured, current-head bound, and checklist/claim bound; empty human looks-good and stale CI artifacts should not satisfy strict gates.
items.userSees: CI/human review evidence includes commit, command/artifact hashes, checked claims, and fails clearly when stale or empty.

happy.desc: Current-head CI/human attestation with checked claims, command/artifact reference, actor, timestamp, and pass result satisfies strict checks.

edge.desc: Story metadata-only changes do not stale a material CI/human attestation.
Legacy evidence without attestation metadata is treated as ordinary evidence unless it explicitly claims CI/human authority.

adversarial.desc: A human reviewer submits only looks-good without checkedClaims or artifact binding; strict validation rejects it as empty attestation.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:attestation-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Current-head CI/human attestations with checkedClaims and command/artifact binding pass strict attestation checks; build and smoke passed at commit ee95302c.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:attestation-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:verification-freshness-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: MaterialHash freshness callback keeps attestation fresh across metadata-only changes; attestation smoke and verification-freshness smoke passed.
Legacy evidence without attestation metadata remains compatible and does not produce attestationIssues.
Strict validation rejects empty human looks-good attestations, empty checkedClaims, unbound CI attestations, and stale CI attestations with detailed attestation diagnostics.

items.title: Add actor trust registry, revocation, and suspicious evidence signals
items.context: Milestone 5: evidence receipts should be checked against actor identity/trust metadata; revoked actors, same-actor producer/verifier, and suspicious pass patterns should warn or block according to policy.
items.userSees: Koala can reject revoked actor evidence and surface suspicious producer/verifier or always-pass reviewer patterns.

happy.desc: Trusted independent actor/verifier metadata is accepted and rendered as healthy trust diagnostics.

edge.desc: Missing actor metadata on low-risk/light flows remains compatible, while balanced surfaces a warning.
Suspicious pass patterns are advisory unless the effective profile requires stricter enforcement.

adversarial.desc: Evidence signed by a revoked actor or by the same actor as producer and verifier is rejected in strict mode.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:actor-trust-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Trusted independent producer/verifier actors and differentiated providers are accepted in strict actor trust checks; build and actor-trust smoke passed at commit feaa0f07.
Missing actorTrust metadata remains compatible in light and warns in balanced when requireActorMetadata is enabled.
Suspicious always-pass actor patterns warn in balanced and block in strict when actorStats indicate repeated 100 percent pass behavior.
Strict mode rejects revoked actors, same producer/verifier actor, same run id, and same producer/verifier provider with detailed actor trust diagnostics.

items.title: Add external fact provenance and freshness policy
items.context: Milestone 6: external factual claims need provenance metadata, source class, fetchedAt/hash/freshness, and conflict/expiry diagnostics so stale or unsupported external facts cannot pass strict gates.
items.userSees: External fact evidence must cite source/provenance and strict validation flags missing, stale, secondary-only, or conflicting sources.

happy.desc: Explicit external_fact evidence with primary-source provenance, fetchedAt, digest/hash, and fresh timestamp passes strict provenance checks.

edge.desc: Non-external verification evidence is not forced to carry source provenance.
Balanced profile warns on secondary-only or soon-expiring provenance without blocking legacy local flows.

adversarial.desc: An agent asserts an external fact with no source, stale source, secondary-only source, or conflicting source set; strict validation rejects it.
